entities.name: Unesh
entities.description: Sovereign of the Criosphinx of Amonkhet, a ram-headed sphinx cursed by Bolas to be unable to communicate.

entities.name: Criosphinx
entities.description: Ram-headed sphinxes of Amonkhet ruled by Unesh, aggressive toward Bolas's agents.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Cursed sphinxes with the inability to communicate.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: City the Criosphinx stay far from.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas placed Unesh under a curse making him utterly incapable of communication.
events.quote: He was placed under the same curse by Nicol Bolas as all of his kind

relations.quote: Unesh is the sovereign of the Criosphinx of Amonkhet.

relations.note: Driven by hatred of Bolas due to his curse.
relations.quote: being driven by the hatred of Bolas due to his curse
